content5.ptxt: When the power window regulator master switch assembly (all seats) is operated, the power window regulator motor assemblies (all seats) are driven. The power window regulator motor assemblies (all seats) have a motor function, regulator function and ECU function.

B2311 is output when an internal malfunction of the power window regulator motor assembly RH (driver side, rear right) or power window regulator motor assembly LH (front passenger side, rear left) is determined, or when the ECU in the power window regulator motor assembly RH (driver side, rear right) or power window regulator motor assembly LH (front passenger side, rear left) determines that there is a difference of approximately 2 cm or more from the normal fully closed window position when a window fully closing operation is performed.

item.ptxt: Identify the power window regulator motor assembly (ECU) at the location that output this DTC (B2311) before inspecting.

When the power window regulator motor assembly RH (driver side, rear RH) or power window regulator motor assembly LH (front passenger side, rear LH) is replaced with a new one, perform power window system registration (see ).

If AUTO UP is operated after replacing the glass, glass run, etc., the jam protection function may operate. In that case, repeating AUTO UP hold ←→ AUTO DOWN operation 5 times or more returns it to normal operation.
Internal malfunction of power window regulator motor assembly (any seat)

When a window fully closing operation is performed, the ECU in the power window regulator motor assembly (any seat) determines a difference of approximately 2 cm or more from the normal fully closed window position
Power window regulator motor assembly (any seat)
Improper installation of power window parts
Overheating of power window regulator motor assembly (any seat)

test2.ptxt: Using SST (TaSCAN), perform the Active Test of the power window regulator motor assembly at the location outputting the DTC.

Open and close the power window at the location outputting the DTC and check that it operates normally.
Check that the power window parts at the location outputting the DTC are installed properly. (Parts such as the glass run that cause the window to close beyond the normal fully closed position)
